hooks.command: bash -c 'g="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/control/gate.py"; p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/venv/Scripts/python.exe"; [ -f "$p" ] || p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}/venv/bin/python"; if [ ! -f "$g" ] || [ ! -f "$p" ]; then echo "CONTROL GATE MISSING - blocked (fail-closed)" >&2; exit 2; fi; "$p" "$g" hook; rc=$?; [ "$rc" = 0 ] && exit 0; exit 2'
